name: csv-table
description: Opens .csv and .tsv files as a sortable table, and adds a Tables page to the rail.

interface.shortDescription: CSV and TSV files as a sortable table.
interface.longDescription: An example plugin with no dependencies: one MCP server, written against the protocol directly, whose tool has a UI (an MCP App) that opens .csv and .tsv files, shows up as a page on the rail, and renders tables agents make.
defaultPrompt: Make a CSV of this project's ten largest files and show it as a table
